input.answer: The job vacancy rate for Canada in August 2026 was 2.9%, unadjusted for seasonality. That is 2.9 unfilled jobs per 100 payroll jobs (job vacancies divided by payroll employees plus job vacancies). The series returned an August 2026 value even though the table's search card listed its range as ending 2026-07. For context, the rate was 3.1% in May 2026, 2.9% in June, and 2.8% in July, so August is 0.1 points above July (2.9 − 2.8 = +0.1). The figure is from Table 14-10-0371 (job vacancies, payroll employees, and job vacancy rate by province and territory, monthly, unadjusted), Canada row, Job vacancy rate statistic.
